hypothesis: N4b high-precision correction has already lowered diagnostic equation residual while float64 SpMV cancellation remains; local original-float64-residual corrections avoid applying ill-conditioned full LU inverse to rounding noise. This is an experiment, not a convergence or attainable-tolerance guarantee.

algorithm.initial_fields: exact N4b final five full fields; four passing fields retained byte for byte
algorithm.residual: exact original float64 CSC Kff @ u - rhs; no alternative accumulator for the gate or update RHS
algorithm.diagonal: positive finite diagonal of unchanged Kff
algorithm.rho: max_i(sum_j(abs(Kff_ij))/Kff_ii), inflated by 1+4*nfree*eps64 then nextafter toward +infinity
algorithm.correction: (-original_float64_residual / original_diagonal) * omega, in this precise operation order
algorithm.stop: first original gate pass or last of exactly 32 iterations; no best-iterate selection
algorithm.longdouble: diagnostic residual only, not acceptance or update RHS

observations_each_update: nonzero correction rounded to no movement
maximum and bins of exact representable ULP distance
original float64 and diagnostic longdouble residuals

capacity.time_basis: 32 local updates use one float64 residual SpMV per update plus saved-field residuals and diagnostic longdouble products, without the eight GMRES inner solves or the 8.01-second LU factorization; retain original 180-second external cap and record any real timeout
